BiblicalUsage: Zibia is an Israelite of Benjamin, named among the sons of Shaharaim. In 1 Chronicles 8:9, Zibia, and Mesha.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zibia matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
